task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Take the curved plastic body small fan with the left arm, put it on the Gray mat, and make it face the robot
